name: 도윤 · 저승길 차림
quote: 붓 끝에 맺힌 기운이 요괴를 잠재우리라.
outfit: 청색과 흰색이 조화된 단정한 한복 도포
accessories: 몸 주변을 떠다니는 빛나는 부적 조각들
silhouette: 커다란 붓을 휘두르는 역동적인 자세, 몸 주변에 흩날리는 부적의 파편 실루엣
signature_motion: 붓으로 허공에 궤적을 그리며 부적을 발사하는 동작
signature_vfx: 붓이 지나간 자리에 밝은 하늘색 글씨가 나타나며 황금빛 폭발이 일어남
visual_en: A 2-head tall chibi exorcist facing right. He has bright gold glowing eyes and black hair tied in a neat topknot. He wears an ivory white and deep navy hanbok robe decorated with crimson red patterns on the sleeves. Several glowing sky blue talisman fragments float around his body. He holds a large, oversized magic brush that emits a brilliant sky blue light at its tip. His feet are clad in white socks and black traditional shoes. The entire character stands out with vivid, saturated colors against dark backgrounds.
features_en: Magic brush emitting sky blue light

Underworld Road outfit: an Underworld Road outfit for the new update: white Korean mourning clothes, a black gat hat of an underworld reaper (jeoseung saja) and small ledger (myeongbu) ornaments, matched to its own weapon and personality
pose_en: Standing firm with a determined gaze, ready to strike.
vfx_en: Sky blue calligraphy strokes exploding into golden sparks.
motion_en: Painting explosive talismans in the air
lore: 퇴마 서생 — 붓으로 그은 자리에 부적이 터진다. 무기 부적 · 붓(부적에 읽히는 글자는 넣지 않는다).
concept: 이 게임 세계(요괴 · 이면 — 한국 설화) 영웅. 2~3등신 치비 도트, 어두운 돌바닥과 밝은 회색 바닥 둘 다에서 보이는 몸 색.

parent_body.body: A small, chibi-style humanoid character with black hair, wearing a white and blue robe with red accents.

derive.prompt: Keep this exact same character: the same face, head, hair, body shape, size, pose and skin, and the same hands holding the same weapon in the same place. Change only the clothing and accessories to an Underworld Road outfit for the new update: white Korean mourning clothes, a black gat hat of an underworld reaper (jeoseung saja) and small ledger (myeongbu) ornaments, matched to its own weapon and personality. Keep the body colors readable on both dark stone and light grey floors (not all black, not all white). Full body, three-quarter view facing right.
